skills.name: majority_recolor
skills.description: Used to solve T0004_a633ef1a1bbaadbb (gravity pulls all cells down → apply rotate180 to all objects → recolor everything to the majority color → color 5 causes all cells to become color 7)

skills.name: sort_by_size
skills.description: Sort objects left-to-right by ascending size

skills.name: identity
skills.description: Used to solve T0005_a31a626e619c8024 (recolor everything to the majority color → fill all enclosed holes with color 2 → gravity pulls all cells up)

skills.name: fill_enclosed
skills.description: Fill enclosed holes with a color

skills.name: majority_color
skills.description: Find the color covering the most area

skills.name: minority_color
skills.description: Find the color covering the least area

skills.name: filter_by
skills.description: Keep only objects matching a predicate

skills.name: largest_object
skills.description: Find the object with most cells

skills.name: smallest_object
skills.description: Find the object with fewest cells
